what: Claude Code v2.1.105 added PreCompact hook support. The hookSpecificOutput format is NOT valid for PreCompact — only for PreToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse. PreCompact must use top-level fields: decision ("approve"|"block"), reason (string), systemMessage (string). Testing if decision:"block" + exit 2 now gives the agent an agentic turn to call aide_remember before compaction.
why: Hook output validation failed during Session D testing — hookSpecificOutput with hookEventName:"PreCompact" rejected. Schema shows PreCompact uses different fields. New v2.1.105 release may fix the blocking limitation.
